arxiv-1908-03991.title: Prospects for Wideband VLBI Correlation in the Cloud
arxiv-1908-03991.creator: Ajay Gill, Lindy Blackburn, Arash Roshanineshat, Chi-Kwan Chan, Sheperd S. Doeleman, Michael D. Johnson, Alexander W. Raymond, Jonathan Weintroub
arxiv-1908-03991.description: Abstract This paper proposes a cloud architecture for the correlation of wide bandwidth VLBI data. Cloud correlation facilitates processing of entire experiments in parallel using flexibly allocated and practically unlimited compute resources. This approach offers a potential improvement over dedicated correlation clusters, which are constrained by a fixed number of installed processor nodes and playback units.

arxiv-1911-12151.title: Decentralized Data-Enabled Predictive Control for Power System Oscillation Damping
arxiv-1911-12151.creator: Linbin Huang, Jeremy Coulson, John Lygeros, Florian Dörfler
arxiv-1911-12151.description: Abstract We employ a novel data-enabled predictive control (DeePC) algorithm in voltage source converter (VSC) based high-voltage DC (HVDC) stations to perform safe and optimal wide-area control for power system oscillation damping. Conventional optimal wide-area control is model-based. However, in practice detailed and accurate parametric power system models are rarely available.

arxiv-2112-08828.title: Enveloping algebras of Krichever-Novikov algebras are not noetherian
arxiv-2112-08828.creator: Lucas Buzaglo
arxiv-2112-08828.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lucas Buzaglo. This work is part of the overarching question of whether it is possible for the universal enveloping algebra of an infinite-dimensional Lie algebra to be noetherian. The main result of this paper is that the universal enveloping algebra of any Krichever-Novikov algebra is not noetherian, extending a result of Sierra and Walton on the Witt (or classical Krichever-Novikov) algebra.

arxiv-2310-01908.title: Improving style transfer in dynamic contrast enhanced MRI using a spatio-temporal approach
arxiv-2310-01908.creator: Adam G. Tattersall, Keith A. Goatman, Lucy E. Kershaw
arxiv-2310-01908.description: Abstract Style transfer in DCE-MRI is a challenging task due to large variations in contrast enhancements across different tissues and time. Current unsupervised methods fail due to the wide variety of contrast enhancement and motion between the images in the series.

arxiv-2310-11570.title: Quantum control of ro-vibrational dynamics and application to light-induced molecular chirality
arxiv-2310-11570.creator: Monika Leibscher, Eugenio Pozzoli, Alexander Blech, Mario Sigalotti, Ugo Boscain, Christiane P. Koch
arxiv-2310-11570.description: Abstract Achiral molecules can be made temporarily chiral by excitation with electric fields, in the sense that an average over molecular orientations displays a net chiral signal [Tikhonov et al., Sci. Adv. 8, eade0311 (2022)]. Here, we go beyond the assumption of molecular orientations to remain fixed during the excitation process.

arxiv-2502-07783.description: Abstract The scaling of model and data sizes has reshaped the AI landscape, establishing finetuning pretrained models as the standard paradigm for solving downstream tasks. However, dominant finetuning methods typically rely on weight adaptation, often lack interpretability, and depend on heuristically chosen hyperparameters.

arxiv-2503-02222.title: Linear Programming Bounds on k k -Uniform States
arxiv-2503-02222.creator: Yu Ning, Fei Shi, Tao Luo, Xiande Zhang
arxiv-2503-02222.description: Abstract The existence of k k -uniform states has been a widely studied problem due to their applications in several quantum information tasks and their close relation to combinatorial objects like Latin squares and orthogonal arrays. With the machinery of quantum enumerators and linear programming, we establish several improved non-existence results and bounds on k k -uniform states.
